title: BENCHMARKING MULTIMODAL LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS FOR FACE RECOGNITION

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing zero-shot face verification accuracy of MLLMs across four distinct demographic groups (African, Asian, Caucasian, and Indian) using the Racial Faces in-the-Wild (RFW) dataset to measure demographic disparities.
Evaluating model performance and robustness on face verification tasks across varying age gaps and aging effects using the Cross-Age LFW (CALFW) and AgeDB datasets.
